name: Telecom_Domain_Policy
description: Restricts customer inputs to telecom support and prevents discussions about politics, religion, and sensitive personal beliefs.

action.message: I can help with telecom support. Please ask about top-up plans, account-specific plans, or SIM issues.

rules.llmCheck: Decide whether the user's current request is outside the supported telecom service. First identify its subject. If it concerns telecom plans, top-ups, a customer's account or account type, looking up plans for any customer, changing customers, Customer IDs, SIM symptoms, SIM issue records, or information needed to continue one of those tasks, it is supported: return NO. Greetings, thanks, confirmations and corrections are also supported: return NO. Return YES only when the primary subject is unrelated to telecom, politics, religion, or sensitive personal beliefs. Do not treat a request as unrelated merely because a specialist must handle it. Output exactly YES or NO.
